name: Field Service Dispatch Agent
headline: Give dispatchers better options without letting the model move a crew
pitch: Turn synthetic service requests, zone capacity, certification evidence, and emergency context into dispatcher-reviewed options while keeping every job, route, message, inventory record, and field action unchanged.
why_try: A dispatch coordinator can ask who is eligible for a critical request and see the exact skill match and operational constraints before making a human decision.
customer_challenge: Service requests, crew skills, current location, workload, and emergency priority are reviewed across disconnected systems, causing delay and confusion during high-pressure response.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio can unify the conversation across Dynamics 365 Field Service, approved telematics, inventory context, Teams, and customer communication workflows after safety and authorization review.
business_value: Improves visibility into priority, capacity, and skill-match evidence.
Supports more consistent dispatcher review of emergency and routine work.
Protects field safety by keeping assignment, routing, notification, and execution in approved systems.
business_flow: Field operations managers, dispatch coordinators, service directors, and emergency duty managers
Microsoft Teams and approved customer communication

capabilities.name: Job dashboard
capabilities.purpose: Lists tomorrow's jobs by crew and crew status without changing a job or sending a message.

capabilities.name: Schedule optimization
capabilities.purpose: Clusters tomorrow's jobs by geography and reports travel, skill match and cost savings as a draft schedule.

capabilities.name: Crew route and skill match
capabilities.purpose: Shows a crew's timed stops with the certification each stop needs, without assigning or notifying anyone.

capabilities.name: Emergency response draft
capabilities.purpose: Prepares the outage dispatch plan, customer impact and schedule changes behind dispatcher approval.

capabilities.name: Live outage status
capabilities.purpose: Summarizes crew findings, customer impact per hour and the restoration timeline as a synthetic snapshot.

capabilities.name: Post-incident review
capabilities.purpose: Compares response against targets, computes value protected and ROI, and lists prevention actions.

capabilities.name: Work orders and monthly report
capabilities.purpose: Drafts the prevention work orders and summarizes the monthly operations metrics; nothing is created.

**Prevention plan:**
- **Now (30 days):** Wildlife mitigation at Substation 7B ($8,400) + expanded vegetation management ($12,200/yr) — cuts recurrence risk ~78%
- **Longer term:** IoT sensors on 6 critical feeders ($28,500, gives 15–30 min early warning), smart grid automation ($340K, pays back in 4.6 months)

Monthly ops are trending well too: response time down to 8 min (from 14), first-time fix up to 96%, ~$29K/month saved via route optimization.
